note: Alberta Parks campground on Fish (Shunda) Lake, 6 km west of Nordegg on Hwy 11 and 2 km south on a gravel access road, run by a contracted operator. Sites are spacious and most are surrounded by trees; Loops 1 and 2 lie between the access road and the lake, and the booking site tags fourteen sites there 'Near Water' (1-01 to 1-06, 2-08, 2-11, 2-13 to 2-18). Electric motors only on the lake; boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning station, cook shelter. Trailers cannot be filled with water here (the agency points to Nordegg). OHVs must stay on their trailers inside the recreation area. --Claude
